texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 3 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The brand color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only the platform shell (status bar, home indicator) — this task has no primary button and no text input. Design all other states, the headers, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the service logos and the icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 3 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in screen order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii and elevation, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only the platform shell (status bar, home indicator) — this task has no primary button and no text input. Design all other states, the headers, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the service logos and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
